notes.title: Version 1.7 is now available!
notes.notes:
Game controls are now reassignable.
The menu has been redesigned with cinematics for each mission.
Several areas of the game have been reworked.
Load times are optimized and now include cinematics.

notes.title: Major update 1.6 - Battle Royale Update - August 2024
notes.notes:
New Update Available Now! 🎉

Dear Players,

I am excited to announce that a new update for Cherry Island is now available on Steam! 🎮

What's New?

New Features:


 Two New Zones for Battle Royale Mode: Explore and conquer the latest additions to our Battle Royale map.
 Revamped Cherry Island Launch Pad: The Launch Pad area on Cherry Island has been completely reworked for better gameplay and strategy.
 Minor bug fixes and performance improvements to enhance your gaming experience.
 


Thank You for Your Support!

We want to extend our gratitude to all our community members for their invaluable feedback and continued support. Your comments help us make the game better with each update. 🙏
Join the Discussion

Don't forget to join our Steam group to share your thoughts and discuss with other players. I can't wait to hear what you think about this update!

Thank you and happy gaming!

Adrien Jeanneret

notes.title: Major Update 1.5 - Battle Royal - October 23
notes.notes:
Welcome to the 1.5 version of Cherry island!

- A Battle Royal mod against bots is now available
- A new massive island called Turtle is now available
- Game performance has been improved
- Visual content has been improved

notes.title: Version 1.01 - Milky way
notes.notes:
Welcome to the 1.01 version of Cherry Island!
Update details:
[olist]
  Full support for 4k screens resolutions
 3 languages added ; french, spanish, german
 Reworked areas with new HD models
 Gameplay fixes
 New 8k milky way sky and buildings lights
[/olist]
Enjoy!

notes.title: April major update b0.4 : Software fixes, car race, ghosts!
notes.notes:
Dear users of Cherry Island,

thank you for buying Cherry Island!

Two new missions are waiting for you; 

A new car race in King Fisher military base.
A survival mission in a secret bunker. 
Volcano area is now a massive jungle fully reworked.
You can also visit the new Flamingo resort on the volcano.

Some softwares fixes about "war crimes" mod for the military police / zombies are done now.
Others fixes are listed in the menu "Guide > Updates"
New render for every cameras make the game more glossy (Depth of field effect)
Next update ; first campagn missions of the Z Corporation

Enjoy ! 
Adrien Jeanneret
PS; Your gaming session about Cherry Island will always loved on Steam workshop, Youtube, Twitch, Instagram, Twitter, ... No mather how you are (Small Twitcher, or famous Youtuber)
